verdict.rationale: PayPal's checkout lets merchants offer PayPal, Venmo, Pay Later (BNPL, e.g. Pay in 4) and cards through one integration. Apple Pay and Google Pay are documented only for in-person contactless acceptance via the PayPal app and for a Braintree agentic-commerce handler, not as online checkout options in the same integration. Bank redirects / local payment methods are not evidenced at all. missing for 10: Apple Pay/Google Pay in the online checkout integration, bank-redirect/local payment methods, independent corroboration that all methods work from one integration

support.subject: As a founder, I can offer digital wallets and local payment methods (Apple Pay, Google Pay, bank redirects, BNPL) from the same integration

citations.quote: Offer up to 400M users1 the choice to pay with PayPal, Venmo, Pay Later, debit and credit cards, and more.
Pay in 4 interest-free payments. Paid every two weeks.
